config.name: deletion.gcInterval
config.description: the interval to garbage collect stale volumes and snapshots, in seconds

config.name: snapshot.shrink
config.description: shrink snapshot after taken

config.name: snapshot.compare
config.description: compare snapshot after shrink, it is recommend to enable if shrink enabled

config.name: qcow2.allocation
config.description: qcow2 allocation policy, can be none, metadata

config.name: qcow2.cluster.size
config.description: qcow2 cluster size, must be power of 2 and between 512 to 2097152, units in bytes

config.name: fencer.check.io
config.description: if enabled, fencer will also check additional io (read operation) to determine sharedblock is invalid and vm is in error

config.name: disable.host.when.storage.failure
config.description: disable host when any shared block storage failure in this host

config.name: fail.if.multipath.no.path
config.description: I/O fail if all paths of multipath device used by sharedblock unavailable, ZStack fencer may work not well if set false

config.name: thin.provisioning.initialize.size
config.description: thin provisioning initialize size, must greater than 1073741824

config.name: thin.provisioning.volume.utilization.percent
config.description: thin provisioning volume utilization percent, if volume write amount exceed the percent, volume will be auto extended

config.name: thin.provisioning.volume.freespace
config.description: thin provisioning volume freespace, if volume free space less than the configure value, volume will be auto extended

config.name: thin.provisioning.volume.increment
config.description: thin provisioning volume increment size, the volume will auto extend with with value each time

config.name: enable.lvmetad
config.description: enable lvmetad, it may corrupt metadata if wrongly use

config.name: lockhelper.max.times
config.description: maxmium times for lockhelper find locked but not used volumes

config.name: lockhelper.protection.period
config.description: protection period to prevent automatic unlocking of lv after activation

config.name: lockhelper.scan.interval
config.description: scan interval in seccond for lockhelper

config.name: sblk.agent.verbose.log
config.description: enable verbose log for zstack-sharedblock-agent

config.name: heartbeat.io.timeout
config.description: sharedblock storage heartbeat io timeout, unit is second

config.name: max.actual.size.factor
config.description: factor of maximum allowed actual size between virtual size, only change it if you know what you are doing

config.name: device.allocate.strategy
config.description: the strategy to allocate device for new shared block volume.

config.name: volume.instantiate.sync.level
config.description: the sync level of instantiating volume on shared block primary storage.

config.name: volume.activate.sync.level
config.description: the sync level of activating volume on shared block primary storage.

config.name: discard.volume.when.deleting
config.description: always means always issuing discards to PVs when deleting LV, never means not issuing discards and auto means that if discards are relatively fast, then discards will be issued.
